name: clef-playground
description: Playground for Cloudflare's Clef decision models: typed questions, images, latency and cost

paragraphs: A small Cloudflare Worker that demos Clef, Cloudflare's decision models. Give it some text (and optionally images, audio, or video) plus a set of typed questions, and it returns calibrated probabilities from clef, clef-flash, and clef-omni side by side, with latency and cost for each call. See the multimodal release post for what changed.
features: Scenarios: support triage, content moderation, image check, call & video review, sales lead scoring. Each one ends with a line of plain code that turns the probabilities into an action.
Question types: noul (yes/no), choice (pick one), score (ordered rubric).
Images: up to 4 PNG/JPEG/WebP files, resized in the browser to 512px before sending, because larger images are much slower. All three models accept images.

Audio and video: clef-omni only. Up to 4 WAV/MP3 files and up to 4 MP4/WebM files, sent unmodified as base64 data URLs. The API's limits, found by testing: 8 MiB per audio clip, 16 MiB per video clip, and roughly 27–35…

Cost: worked out from usage.inputtokens using Workers AI list prices per million input tokens: $0.24 for clef, $0.038 for clef-flash, and $0.15 for clef-omni. Note that hosted clef-flash now has a 24k-token context…
